item.title: Stakeholder Theory and Responsible Business: The Future of Corporate Governance
item.content:encoded:
This Special Issue seeks to address challenges by advancing scholarship on stakeholder theory, responsible business, and corporate governance. The issue welcomes conceptual, empirical, and theory-building contributions that examine stakeholder governance in contemporary institutional environments. Submissions from corporate governance scholars across a range of disciplines are particularly encouraged, including perspectives from management, strategy, ethics, finance, accounting, and law.

Potential topics

  • Stakeholder theory and its applications in corporate governance
  • Responsible business practices and stakeholder management
  • Stakeholder governance in contemporary institutional environments
  • Corporate governance mechanisms and stakeholder protection
  • Interdisciplinary perspectives on stakeholder theory (management, strategy, ethics, finance, accounting, law)

Timeline

  • December 1, 2026: Proposal submissions deadline
